title: 05_network 5_GO_semantic_clustering pipeline parameters
description: GO semantic clustering (Fig 2c/2e), OCD 'NA' detail (Fig 2d), GO fold-enrichment barchart (Fig 3b), and community gene-enrichment tileplots (Fig 3d/e).

dep_only_go.description: DEP_ONLY_hierarchy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — run1 (human-only) GO enrichment for depression.

dep_ccd_go.description: DEP_CCD_hierachy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — run2 (human+dogCD) GO enrichment for depression.

ocd_only_go.description: OCD_ONLY_hierachy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — run1 (human-only) GO enrichment for OCD.

sch_only_go.description: SCH_ONLY_hierachy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — run1 (human-only) GO enrichment for schizophrenia.

sch_ccd_go.description: SCH_CCD_hierachy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — run2 (human+dogCD) GO enrichment for schizophrenia.

dogcd_go.description: CCD_ONLY_hierachy_full_GO_enrichment.tsv (data/05_network/) — single-species, dog-only GO enrichment for dogCD (no run1/run2 pair). Feeds the semantic clustering's dogCD group and, downstream, Fig. 2e's semantic-similarity panel.

cache_gpt_labels.description: cache_gpt_labels.top_community.cut60.txt (data/05_network/5_GO_semantic_clustering/) — frozen GPT cluster-label cache; not regenerated.

goa_human_gaf.description: goa_human.gaf.gz (data/05_network/5_GO_semantic_clustering/) — frozen GO Consortium human annotation file.

seed_genes_csv.description: gene_list_gwas_catalog_overlap_with_region.csv (data/07_additional_plots_and_analyses/) — frozen export of the seed-gene Google Sheet tab (gene, dog seed, human seed, dogCD P columns).

openai_api_key.description: Passed as OPENAI_API_KEY to 01_semantic_clustering.R, which requires this env var to be non-empty unconditionally even when the frozen GPT-label cache already covers every cluster. Only needs to be a real key if semantic re-clustering produces cluster IDs absent from that cache.
